## About
Down River Body Works is an owner-operated collision shop in Allen Park, run by Douglas Vizachero. The goal is simple: properly restore your damaged vehicle to pre-accident condition as quickly and painlessly as possible, and to factory specifications.
Our staff is trained with I-Car, ATEG, and ASE certifications, because repair standards for new vehicles keep changing. In the paint booth we use the Nitrothermspray system, which uses nitrogen instead of compressed air for a better finish and less paint waste.
Reviewers talk about Doug by name. One said he took the time to look at the best possible parts for his Chevy Impala. Another called the shop honest, transparent, and professional. We hold a 4.6 rating from 125 Google reviews.

## Services
- Unibody & Frame Straightening: Precise straightening on state-of-the-art equipment to restore your vehicle's structural integrity after a collision.
- Expert Color Matching: We match your vehicle's original paint so the repaired panel blends with the rest of the car.
- Insurance Repair: We work with whatever insurance company is handling your claim.
- Air Bag / SRS: Airbag and Supplemental Restraint System repair after an accident, so your safety systems work as designed.
- Fiberglass Repair: Fiberglass panels repaired for durability and precision.
- Vehicle Pick Up & Delivery: We can pick up your vehicle and bring it back, whether you're at home or work.
- Custom Work: Unique paint jobs, body modifications and performance upgrades.
- U-Haul Rental Services: Rent a U-Haul right here at the shop on Old Goddard.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with whatever insurance company is handling your claim.

Q: What if I have an accident after hours or on the weekend?
A: Call our towing company, City Towing, Inc., at 313.388.9200 in Lincoln Park to arrange a tow to our facility.

Q: Can I get a rental car while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. Company Car Rental is on site. Reach them at 313-383-9300, Monday-Friday 8am-5pm.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. Our team handles foreign and domestic vehicles, all makes and models.
